title: Restricted Fourier weight triple observation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates, let $J$ be a finite subset of those coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. For an ordered triple of full sign vectors $(z,y,y')\in(\{\pm1\}^n)^3$, the restricted Fourier weight triple observation is the restricted Fourier weight observation obtained from $f,J,S$ and the three inputs $z,y,y'$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
The input is an ordered triple of full sign vectors on the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The underlying restricted Fourier weight observation and its interpretation are not defined in the payload.
